# OSO CDC Connector for Oracle Database
> Open-source (Apache-2.0) Kafka Connect source connector that captures change data from Oracle Database through LogMiner, by OSO. Built for correctness and operability: no silent data loss, a durable transaction journal, bounded memory, resumable snapshots, multi-PDB capture, exactly-once delivery, a preflight doctor and drop-in migration from Confluent and Debezium. Current release: 0.1.2 (preview), on Maven Central under the group sh.oso.

## Core documentation
- [Introduction](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/): what the connector is and the status of each capability
- [Getting started](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/getting-started): Docker Compose and Strimzi labs, installation, first connector
- [Installation](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/getting-started/installation): the plugin ZIP, Maven Central coordinates and supported versions
- [Database setup](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/database-setup): ARCHIVELOG, supplemental logging and the mining user generated by oracle-cdc-doctor setup-sql
- [Oracle CDC to Kafka](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/guides/oracle-cdc-to-kafka): an end-to-end guide

## Concepts
- [How capture works](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/concepts/how-capture-works): LogMiner steps, the redo byte address cursor, uncommitted transactions
- [Transaction buffer and journal](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/concepts/transaction-buffer-and-journal): bounded memory, spill to disk, long transactions
- [Offsets and recovery](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/concepts/offsets-and-recovery): what the position stores and how a restart resumes
- [Exactly-once delivery](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/concepts/exactly-once): Kafka transactions at Oracle commit boundaries
- [Snapshots](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/concepts/snapshots): chunked, SCN-anchored, resumable
- [Schema and DDL](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/concepts/schema-and-ddl): schema versions per row and the lag case
- [Multi-PDB capture](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/concepts/multi-pdb)

## Reference
- [Configuration](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/reference/configuration): every cdc.* property
- [Record formats](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/reference/record-formats): Debezium-compatible envelope, types, LOBs, Avro names
- [Metrics](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/reference/metrics)
- [Error classes](https://kafkacdcconnector.com/reference/error-classes): CDC-nnnn codes and their runbooks
